<!-- GENERATED by scripts/compile-contracts.mjs from contracts/rules. Edit the rule files, then run npm run contracts:compile. -->

- **invariant** `model/shared-element-identity-contract-dom-derived`: `getTemplateParts` (with `detectPrefix` and `countLines`) is THE shared element-identity contract: DOM-derived `{selector, kind, label, channel}` parts, single-token selectors only. Timeline labels, canvas selection and step assignment must ALL name elements through it rather than inventing their own selector.
- **rule** `model/masked-text-line-recognised-under-own`: A masked text line is recognised under ITS OWN graphic's prefix - the host's, or an INSERTED graphic's namespaced one (a `data-gfx` root carrying its own `-box`, from `blocks/templateInsert.ts`). Such parts carry `inserted: true`, which is how they can be full registry parts - selectable, animatable, named by their field titles - while `countLines`, the count the preset emitters size choreography from, keeps counting the host's lines only.
- **rule** `model/numbered-sibling-family-becomes-part-per`: A numbered sibling family becomes ONE PART PER SIBLING, labelled by the word that sibling carries - the quiz's option rows and the alert category's severity blocks are recognised the same way. One shared class matching four elements has nowhere to put four different values, and the level machine gives each block its own opacity track.
